_meta.description: ILM for caddy-access-* (Caddy access-log evidence shipped by Filebeat, FRE-1146 / ADR-0132 D3). Monthly client-bucketed indices (FRE-1036 convention), no rollover. Retention: 90d, the established default for a new family with no existing precedent (matches agent-monitors-slm-health, agent-topology, agent-monitors-cache-reset-cadence). warm forcemerge at min_age 32d (per the FRE-1036 fix: a monthly index is still open at less than 32d, so an earlier min_age would forcemerge a still-written index). Note: min_age is measured from index creation, so documents written late in a given month's bucket get less than a full 90 days before deletion — a property of the FRE-1036 mechanism itself, not unique to this family.
